subject: Nerve stimulation for sleep apnea showed wider health gains
script: From Agewell Brief: Nerve stimulation for sleep apnea showed wider health gains. A new analysis suggests that treating obstructive sleep apnea with hypoglossal nerve stimulation could improve overall health, but experts urge caution. Over 80 million U.S. adults have sleep apnea. The condition raises risks for diabetes and heart disease. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
